title: pytorch pt2 tests: build a malicious-payload pt2 archive by swapping the sample-inputs record, and gate tests on torch >= 2.10
answers: How do I write a test that checks a pytorch pt2 model rejects a pickle payload?
Which torch version do the pt2 pickle-guard tests need?
Where is the helper that replaces the example-inputs record in a pt2 archive?
body:
Path: tests/pytorch/test_pytorch_model_export.py covers the pt2 pickle guard: pt2 save via mlflow.pytorch.save_model, load via mlflow.pytorch.load_model and mlflow.pyfunc.load_model, with MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION toggled by monkeypatch.
Rule: To simulate a crafted pt2 archive, call _replace_pt2_sample_inputs_record on the model's data/model.pt2 with a torch.save'd object whose __reduce__ writes a marker file (e.g. _FileCreatingPayload). It rewrites the zip and returns the record name, which tests match with pytest.raises(match=...). Assert the marker file does not exist, since validation must reject before unpickling. Guard these tests with skipif torch < 2.10, because the validator refuses older torch.
Symptom: n/a (test convention).
Constraints: The helper targets the sample-inputs record, which is unpickled by torch.export.load; the record name differs across torch versions, so the helper matches by suffix or '/sample_inputs/'. Payloads that should pass (allowlisted via torch.serialization.safe_globals) need a separate test, because the validator ignores the ambient registry.
applies: tests for the pytorch pt2 pickle-free loading guard; reuse only when writing new pt2 guard tests.
says: Verify that exported PyTorch models reject malicious archive payloads before loading.
Add automated tests ensuring untrusted model files cannot run code during import.
Security regression tests for exported PyTorch models are skipped on older versions.
Test that model deserialization blocks crafted sample inputs without creating marker files.
search: Tests for the PyTorch pt2 pickle-free load guard in tests/pytorch/test_pytorch_model_export.py simulate malicious archives by using _replace_pt2_sample_inputs_record to inject a _FileCreatingPayload into the sample-inputs record of data/model.pt2. The tests must verify that the marker file does not exist, assert rejection via pytest.raises, and gate execution with skipif on torch < 2.10. The helper matches the sample-inputs record by suffix or /sample_inputs/, and tests for allowlisted safe globals require separate test cases because ambient registries are ignored.
